message.reasoning_content: Vote weight 3 means primary action passed? Actually vote_weight_mode 1... I'm player 0 with weight 3 (skipped action gives +2). Others produced. I should produce? But if I act, lose +2 weight. Vote weight matters for law votes. Skip action to keep weight 3? Influence matters for final bonus. Passing action gives +2 weight only this round's law vote. Producing gives goods worth money. 2 goods × ~10 alashi = 20 alashi, but tax maybe. Weight 3 vs 1 for law vote — modest. Production worth ~20 alashi each round; long-term better to produce.
